survivor_baseline_note: Empty and unrecorded. The FIRST engine run writes this list itself and flips survivor_baseline_recorded to true; every later run is scored against it, so a survivor that appears afterwards is a test that stopped defending its code. No agent ever writes this field -- hand-authored baselines are forbidden (KB-MUT-02), and an unrecorded baseline is why a fresh campaign used to be red on every run.
title: Generated mutants for src/conductor/mutation_campaign_generate.py, scored on the survivor set
